training_data: 1,106 windows, 164 positive and 942 negative, drawn from 8 videos of WU-SAHZU patients pat01, pat02, pat05 and pat13 and read as track and pose features, never as imagery.
backbone_pretrain: None; the verifier is a small temporal convolutional network trained from random initialisation, so its upstream lineage is the lineage of the detector and pose models that produced its track trees.
